_README: Your Hack The Box log. Add a machine when you own it and a module when it hits 100%. Copy the matching _example block into "machines" or "modules", fill it in, and run: python3 tools/build.py. Order doesn't matter; the build sorts newest first and does all the counting. Full guide: EDITING.md, Recipe 9.
